{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Cherokee Natural Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kunc.org/business/2014-10-17/xcel-opens-new-gas-pipeline-to-ready-for-the-shift-from-coal|title=kunc.org|website=kunc.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bizwest.com/?p=321834|title=bizwest.com|website=bizwest.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Fort Lupton, Colorado to Cherokee Station, Commerce City, Colorado.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kunc.org/business/2014-10-17/xcel-opens-new-gas-pipeline-to-ready-for-the-shift-from-coal|title=kunc.org|website=kunc.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bizwest.com/?p=321834|title=bizwest.com|website=bizwest.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

*'''Owner: '''Public Service Company of Colorado<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kunc.org/business/2014-10-17/xcel-opens-new-gas-pipeline-to-ready-for-the-shift-from-coal|title=kunc.org|website=kunc.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.faegredrinker.com/zh/services/experience/2014/12/xcel-energy-acquires-right-of-way-for-cherokee-gas-transmission-line|title=faegredrinker.com|website=faegredrinker.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kunc.org/business/2014-10-17/xcel-opens-new-gas-pipeline-to-ready-for-the-shift-from-coal|title=kunc.org|website=kunc.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bizwest.com/?p=321834|title=bizwest.com|website=bizwest.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
